findings.citation: spec.md Constraints: "No test writes to the user's compose stack, including `postgres-demo`. No e2e step rewrites a `billing_month` in the database."
findings.note: The money e2e calls rollSeededAgentInvoiceIntoThePast() (frontend/tests/e2e/helpers.ts:516), an `update agent_invoices set billing_month = ...`; without E2E_DATABASE_URL it runs via `docker compose exec postgres` (the user's stack). Reach the send/approve Payout steps another way.

Testing decision 4 asks for counts equal to the API list lengths; the test reads the pages' 'N in this tenant' subtitles instead. Fixer contests: no browser-reachable list GET exists (app/api/{clients,agents,contracts} export only POST; JWT httpOnly); the subtitle is rows.length of the same list read.

findings.citation: docs/agents/coding-standards.md: Backend 3. The transaction boundary is the service method (`@Transactional`), never the repository or the controller
findings.note: @Transactional on the controller; move the write into a service. ManagerName.Refused then crosses the service->controller boundary and per Backend 7 carries @ResponseStatus(BAD_REQUEST), like ChangePasswordRefusedException.

findings.citation: docs/agents/coding-standards.md: Backend 2. Business rules live in the service layer; a controller translates HTTP <-> domain and never branches on domain state.
findings.note: ManagerName.of and the row write run in the controller.

findings.citation: docs/agents/coding-standards.md: Backend 2. Business rules live in the service layer; a controller translates HTTP <-> domain and never branches on domain state.
findings.note: managerName() branches on Role and reads UserRepository in the controller.

findings.citation: docs/agents/coding-standards.md: Backend 12. Table-driven tests (`@ParameterizedTest` + `@MethodSource`) for any method with more than two branch conditions, instead of copy-pasted per-case tests.
findings.note: Four copy-pasted @Test methods for ManagerName.of's edge cases (100, 101, empty, whitespace-only).

findings.citation: docs/agents/coding-standards.md: Frontend 13. Route Handlers reuse a shared forwarder from `lib/api`: `forwardJson` for a plain JSON answer, `forwardSecretJson` when the body carries a secret, `forwardBinary` for a file — never an ad hoc shape per route.
findings.note: GET can use forwardJson; the 204 PUT needs a shared 204-safe forwarder in lib/api.
Possible Shotgun Surgery: viewerCanChangeName hand-added to 13 Manager pages; could come from the surface/layout.
Possible Repeated Switches: ref slots computed by `onChangeName ? n : m`; map an item list.
Possible Mysterious Name: named like a value type but is a static validator returning String.
Possible Duplicated Code: /api/me body shape declared locally and cast inline; export one type from lib/api/types.ts.

findings.citation: web-design-guidelines — Forms: 'Inputs need autocomplete and meaningful name'
findings.note: The Name input has autoComplete but no name attribute.
autoFocus fires on mobile too (mirrors ChangePasswordDialog).
A save off the Dashboard changes nothing visible; consider a status line.
No maxLength={100} on the input though the backend caps at 100.
On mobile the chip truncates the role ('Yazan Abuhassan · Man…'); truncate the name segment instead.
No loading state: seven reads in one Promise.all with no loading.tsx/Suspense.
'Couldn't load …' messages give no next step; the count cards could link to their lists.
Untouched Pending cards use a bare indigo '—' with no SR text while the rewritten cards use UNAVAILABLE_FIGURE.
DESIGN.md § Menu still lists only 'Change password and Log out' for the viewer chip menu.

The dashboard spec (Solution, ~lines 219-230) says an adjustment is 'a fifth figure' on an Agent Invoice added to total(ai); docs/features/invoice-adjustment/spec.md says 'The Agent Invoice gains no new figure' (it moves Local Support Fees through payableAmountForMonth). Correct the dashboard spec's wording to match invoice-adjustment. Evidence: evidence/step-16.txt.
